title: Refusal / turn limit reached in a crisis conversation
description: The conversational layer reaches its refusal count or maximum turns during a safety interaction.
callerVisible: The call exits to the deterministic safety route; it is never terminated by the limit.
backendEvidence: Exit reason LIMIT_REACHED routed to safety branch
notes: Whether the vendor guardrail exit can route back to Studio is UNKNOWN (TB-05, PRQ-017).
